title: Playing the Palace Theatre shows
summary: Weekly rehearsals and shows at the Ritz and Palace between movies, with comedians and chorus girls.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Tell me more about the Palace. What's that like, playing there?
Well, playing there we did, we rehearsal every Tuesday morning. And we do a show at the Ritz on Tuesday night. And Wednesday night we play the Palace and Saturdays.
I don't know what the Ritz is. I never saw that. What was that?

That's upon Howard and Philly City. The theater right on the corner. Anybody see the Ritz? Yeah. And then we used to do the gym later on. They made the gym at the Hotel and Broad. How was it in Philly City?
That's the sound in Philly City there?
Yeah, I passed it. Yeah. Yeah, we used to play there every Tuesday night. And we'd make run and whistle a week for the show. Same show. Uh-huh. And that was the set up.
Would they play the movies the same night you were there?

Yeah. We'd do our something show. Uh-huh. And in other words, we'd do a show around 3 or 3.30, and we'd go out, we'd do whatever you wanted to do, and we'd do a show at 7 and 9. 9 would be the last. And the movies would be in between. That's right. I see. And what would you do with the band? Would you just play music or would they dance? We'd play for the show, yeah. We'd play for the show for the volleyball. Well what kind of acts would they have then?
Well they had the comedians and different acts, different out-of-town acts used to come
too. And of course, the girls, the real show. Uh-huh. Singing, dance.
